sports.headline: LA28 names Phillips 66 its official fuel partner, drawing backlash from critics
sports.summary: Phillips 66 will supply fuel for vehicles and equipment at the 2028 Games and for the torch relay. Two LA City Council members and environmental critics have called for the deal to be cancelled. Critics now have an early flashpoint over fossil-fuel sponsorship ahead of the Games.

sports.headline: Davis Cup Final 8 opens in Bologna as Czechia beat Canada to reach the semi-finals
sports.summary: Jiri Lehecka beat Felix Auger-Aliassime and Tomas Machac beat Liam Draxl to give Czechia a 2-0 win on day one. Hosts Italy face South Korea on 25 November, and Great Britain, Germany, Spain and Austria play on 26 November. Rolex has also extended its Davis Cup partnership.

fashion.headline: Shein to pay $100 million to settle FTC deceptive-practices case
fashion.summary: The FTC says Shein misled US shoppers on shipping times, suppressed negative reviews and made deceptive cotton-origin and supply-chain claims. The settlement needs court approval and bars Shein from those practices. It is roughly ten times the largest comparable review-and-shipping penalty, and comes after Shein's Hong Kong listing in September. Shein says it does not admit liability.

fashion.headline: Dick's Sporting Goods shares surge as Foot Locker returns to growth
fashion.summary: Dick's raised its full-year earnings forecast after Foot Locker posted 0.5% comparable-sales growth, with the US banner up more than 4%. Shares jumped about 15%, with some reports putting the intraday gain at 17%. Foot Locker still expects a $40m-$80m full-year loss, and management said Nike's Jordan reset will be painful for it in the short term.

marketing.headline: Meta launches AI shopping agent Muse in the UK with M&S, Asos and JD Sports as launch partners
marketing.summary: The agent can shop on users' behalf and arrives at the start of the holiday season. Marks & Spencer, Asos and JD Sports are signed up as launch partners, a notable step for AI-led retail marketing in the UK.
